telemetry.interpretation: Whole-verifier context only. System CPU is interval utilization across logical CPUs including this benchmark; process cpu_core_percent is relative to one logical CPU and may exceed 100. The first CPU observation is excluded. Cumulative disk deltas cover only adjacent valid samples. PID/create_time changes, unavailable processes and counter resets are never bridged or filled with zero. Nominal 200ms polling includes acquisition and scheduling gaps; missing-periodic counts estimate skipped nominal slots. No per-query interpolation, process-specific slowdown causality, Ollama token speed or optimization claim follows. Observer work remains part of this measured environment.

interpretation.query_spread: Per-repeat row statistics compare distinct fixed queries within one cell.
interpretation.temporal_variation: Ranges and signed later-minus-earlier pairs compare the same query within its original cohort only.
interpretation.weighting: For each query take repeat minimum, median or maximum; then take its cell mean or maximum and multiply by structural population. These six descriptive scenarios combine separate windows, not simultaneous benchmark repeats.
interpretation.accounting: Rank contains vote SQL and is nested in verification. Core is same-row verification plus append excluding nested commit and direct budget writes. Component scenarios must not be added. Setup, tail, all chunk commits and budget totals are separate diagnostics with overlapping containment; no overhead is added to weighted scenarios.
interpretation.limits: Fixed nonrandom samples and uncontrolled cache/system states provide no confidence interval, causal speedup, future latency guarantee or full-run runtime bound. Historical CPU/background-process telemetry was not retained; timing variation cannot be attributed to Ollama or any specific process.
interpretation.reinforcement: Five different identities per target cell: four new plus one explicitly old anchor. All three fresh repeats are retained; historical V6 anchor timings remain separate machine windows, not paired optimization evidence.

historical_anchor_interpretation: Same scientific identities in different machine windows; descriptive temporal differences only, not an optimization speedup estimate.
telemetry_interpretation: Read-only 200ms target background observations span each verifier including setup, queries, append and tail. Sampler scheduling/CPU overhead is part of the environment, not an additional timer to sum. Only repeat-level associations are available; no per-query attribution or Ollama causality is established.
